summary: Weekly review for Sep 13–20, 2026: P520 services stack complete, NAS architecture settled, Marketplace MCP live, school work landed.

sections.heading: ✅ This Week's Highlights
items: **1. P520 Homelab: Full Services Stack Built** — Massive infrastructure push. The P520 went from bare Proxmox to a production homelab: 33 containers across 7 compose files, internal TLS via Caddy, media pipeline live end-to-end (6 indexers + FlareSolverr for Cloudflare), Grafana→ntfy alerting, and a restore drill that passed. The "services stack" saga is effectively done.

**2. NAS + Storage Architecture Settled** — ZFS tank rebuilt as native 5-wide RAIDZ1 (14.4 TiB usable). Storage allocation locked: SSD pool for VMs + games share, HDD pool for bulk. iSCSI rejected, Unraid re-confirmed declined. 2.5GbE NIC installed and active.

**3. Marketplace MCP Fully Live** — Facebook Marketplace Navigator bot built (Muse Spark 1.3 on flat-rate opencode-go), burner login cleared, search/detail verified end-to-end with real listings. First specialist bot in the fleet.
**4. School Work Landed** — CMPE148 Project 1 completed (packet captures, PDF, GitHub push). EchoSphere Drive hub built (227 items reorganized). Daily Drive Organizer cron deployed.
**5. Bonsai 2 27B + Jev Decision Model Wired** — First local LLM in the fleet (35.5 t/s decode on RTX 3060). Jev decision model wired at ~$0.62/mo for queue triage.
